exposure: Duration of second stage of labor
cohort: Term singleton newborns with moderate or severe HIE requiring therapeutic hypothermia (cases) and matched controls without HIE (controls)
finding: Smoking, induction of labor, and obstetric emergencies (especially shoulder dystocia) were associated with an increased risk of HIE requiring therapeutic hypothermia in term newborns.
mod_finding: Induction of labor was associated with increased risk for hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy and need for therapeutic hypothermia in term neonates.
